title: Inlet Beach "Pickleton Place" 329 Winston Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool and spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $120 per day.- 7 adult bikes- Pickleball court- Beginning March 1, 2024, a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle is included- Game room with pool table- Elevator access to all 4 floors- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Pickleton Place is a wonderful 3-story, 7-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom home that sleeps 22 in the Inlet Beach community. Guests will love the pool table, rooftop deck with Gulf views, and the outdoor entertainment area with a private pool, pickleball/tennis courts, and more. The nearest beach access is only a 2-minute walk!Discover the ultimate entertainment hub on the first floor, with a wet bar and game room featuring a pool table and a crystal chess board. Access the covered outdoor kitchen from here, where guests can enjoy the natural gas grill, alfresco dining table, and seating next to an outdoor fireplace. Sit poolside in 4 loungers or take a dip in the private pool before relaxing in the attached sitting spa. And prepare for some friendly competition in the side yard, boasting a pickleball/tennis court that doubles as a half basketball court. After a day of fun in the sun, retreat to the 2 guest bedrooms on this floor with private bathrooms—1 bedroom with a king bed and 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds.Take the stairs or in-home elevator to access the second-floor great room. Relax and unwind in the living area on comfortable furnishings surrounding an electric fireplace and an impressive 85” TV. Enjoy access to the second-floor balcony with comfy seating off the great room. The pristine white kitchen has granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a large island that doubles as a 5-stool breakfast bar. An adjoining dining area offers a mix of chair and bench seating for guests. A primary bedroom provides a king bed and a private balcony with 2 lounge chairs.The third floor offers versatility for sleeping arrangements—3 guest bedrooms with king beds (2 with a private balcony) and 1 playful bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds. There’s also a laundry room and a coffee bar.A rooftop deck with seating overlooking the Gulf!Pickleton Place offers resort-style living in the comfort of a private Gulf home. With on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 7 adult bikes—it’s easy to explore the area. For the nearest beach access, head west on Winston Lane until the road curves north, and Winston Lane Public Beach Access will be visible on the left. Book this coastal home now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 22):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: (2) Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Inlet Beach "Pickleton Place" 329 Winston Lane Inlet Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-115552 Bedrooms 7 Beds 13 Sleeps 22 Full Baths 7 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private pool and spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $120 per day. - 7 adult bikes - Pickleball court - Beginning March 1, 2024, a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle is included - Game room with pool table - Elevator access to all 4 floors - Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1-Oct 31) - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Pickleton Place is a wonderful 3-story, 7-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom home that sleeps 22 in the Inlet Beach community. Guests will love the pool table, rooftop deck with Gulf views, and the outdoor entertainment area with a private pool, pickleball/tennis courts, and more. The nearest beach access is only a 2-minute walk! Discover the ultimate entertainment hub on the first floor, with a wet bar and game room featuring a pool table and a crystal chess board. Access the covered outdoor kitchen from here, where guests can enjoy the natural gas grill, alfresco dining table, and seating next to an outdoor fireplace. Sit poolside in 4 loungers or take a dip in the private pool before relaxing in the attached sitting spa. And prepare for some friendly competition in the side yard, boasting a pickleball/tennis court that doubles as a half basketball court. After a day of fun in the sun, retreat to the 2 guest bedrooms on this floor with private bathrooms—1 bedroom with a king bed and 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds. Take the stairs or in-home elevator to access the second-floor great room. Relax and unwind in the living area on comfortable furnishings surrounding an electric fireplace and an impressive 85” TV. Enjoy access to the second-floor balcony with comfy seating off the great room. The pristine white kitchen has granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a large island that doubles as a 5-stool breakfast bar. An adjoining dining area offers a mix of chair and bench seating for guests. A primary bedroom provides a king bed and a private balcony with 2 lounge chairs. The third floor offers versatility for sleeping arrangements—3 guest bedrooms with king beds (2 with a private balcony) and 1 playful bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds. There’s also a laundry room and a coffee bar. A rooftop deck with seating overlooking the Gulf! Pickleton Place offers resort-style living in the comfort of a private Gulf home. With on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 7 adult bikes—it’s easy to explore the area. For the nearest beach access, head west on Winston Lane until the road curves north, and Winston Lane Public Beach Access will be visible on the left. Book this coastal home now!
